rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (42 FR 4323): EO 11962 of Jan. 19, 1977 establishes the President's Advisory Board on International Investment under the International Investment Survey Act of 1976, with advice, staffing, compensation and FACA provisions, and Sec. 6 ends the Board on Dec. 31, 1978 unless sooner extended; identity is confirmed. The held FR text of EO 12007 (42 FR 42839, Aug. 22, 1977) says in Sec. 5 that the Board is terminated and that Executive Order No. 11962 of January 19, 1977 is revoked, with no deferred effect; this comes before the own-terms sunset, and the current 22 U.S.C. 3107 note (current-law MENTIONS) agrees. Cruden found no other ending text, so the whole order ended 1977-08-22 and status no holds.
